company.name: Kalshi
company.shortDescription: Kalshi is a regulated prediction market where users trade event-based contracts tied to real-world outcomes.
company.description: Kalshi is a federally regulated financial exchange that allows investors to trade directly on the anticipated outcome of future events. Kalshi’s markets cover a wide range of topics, including economics, international affairs, media and entertainment, climate/weather, and public health. Because Kalshi’s market topics can be more specific than those of other instruments, such as stocks or bonds, investors can gain direct exposure to the events and trends that interest them.

productsAndServices.description: A regulated U.S. exchange for trading contracts tied to real-world events, with real-time pricing, order execution, and portfolio management through a web application.
productsAndServices.name: Kalshi Exchange

productsAndServices.description: Binary and outcome-based contracts that allow users to trade on whether specified real-world events or measurable conditions will occur.
productsAndServices.name: Event Contracts

productsAndServices.description: Leveraged contracts for trading whether an underlying price will move up or down, with up to 6x leverage and no expiration.
